Assignment Title: Subscription Billing Calculator — Method Overriding and Dynamic Dispatch

Assignment Question:
A streaming platform offers subscriptions through different plans such as Basic and Premium. Each plan has its own cost calculation.
Design a Java program using the following class hierarchy:
      Subscription
         /    \
        /      \
BasicSubscription  PremiumSubscription
Create a base class Subscription to store common subscription details and provide a method for calculating the subscription cost. It should also provide a method to log the subscription activation.
Create BasicSubscription and PremiumSubscription classes that inherit from Subscription and provide their own implementations of the cost calculation.
For a basic subscription, calculate the cost using:
Cost = Duration (months) × 5.0
For a premium subscription, calculate the cost using:
Cost = 10 + (Duration (months) × 7.5)
A premium subscription also has an additional priority support fee of 4.0.
The program should create the appropriate subscription object and store it using a common Subscription reference. Use this reference to log the activation and calculate the cost, demonstrating method overriding and dynamic method dispatch.
For a premium subscription, use downcasting to access the premium-specific priority support fee and include it in the total cost.
The subscription logging method should be common to all subscription types and should not be overridden.
Input Format
The input consists of three lines:
1. Subscription type (Basic or Premium) 2. User name 3. Duration in months
Constraints
• Subscription type must be Basic or Premium. • User name must be non-empty and must not contain numeric characters. • Duration must be a positive integer. • Numeric input must be valid.
Output Format
For valid input:
Subscription activated for: <userName>
Total Cost: <totalCost>
For invalid input:
Invalid Input
Sample Test Case 
Input:
Basic
Anjali
6
Output:
Subscription activated for: Anjali
Total Cost: 30.0
